places-raco-gasparo-valmayor-v.story: A 166 km round trip from Ares del Maestre - roughly 2 h 52 in the saddle. On the way it passes mas d'en Josep- Abric l, Abric del mas dels Ous, Valmayor V and back through Abric del mas dels Ous. The highest point is about 1,100 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 48 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-the-palace-and-park-of-the-znamen.story: 361 km from Peterhof to Peterhof, about 6 h 34 of riding. It goes by way of Tolbukhin Lighthouse on Tolbukhin Island, Yukkovskaya Elevation, Koltushskoe Highway and Lindulovskaya Roshcha. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
